summary: Changed note embedding from title+summary to title-only in daemon.js (3 locations: note creation ~2118, backfill-embeddings ~2229, reembed ~2257). Also added force:true support to /overlay/reembed endpoint so existing notes with correct-dim vecs can be force-refreshed, and added graph-store persistence (note_vec_set events) in the reembed path. Re-embedded all 231 notes. Search score for "resolveOwner task transcript" improved from 0.591 (before) to 0.643 (after) — +8.8% top1 cosine similarity.
